research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Implemented assigned logistic regression and isotonic calibration routines using predefined training splits to examine probability estimates on imbalanced classification datasets.
Generated reliability diagrams and summarized Brier scores across specified class distributions, documenting discrepancies for review with the research team.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded missing or damaged items, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff.
Maintained order paperwork, organized stockroom supplies, and prepared outgoing packages according to established packing and dispatch procedures.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Housing Price Prediction
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines with scikit-learn, applying missing-value imputation and feature scaling within training pipelines.
Selected regularization settings through cross-validation and compared held-out prediction errors, inspecting residual plots for systematic differences across price ranges.
